answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 28 identities means 28 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the zephyr pair is tracked in the nadir ledger, the crystal audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 27%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
